links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses versus NIH sixth-grade benchmark
links.effect: All models exceeded the sixth-grade level on grade-based indices (ARI 13.49 ± 2.92 to 15.81 ± 3.25); OLWF 61.44 to 72.96 versus benchmark 94.
links.quote: All models exceeded the NIH recommended sixth grade level on grade-based indices (for example, ARI ranged from 13.49 ± 2.92 to 15.81 ± 3.25).

links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-facing answers relative to public health literacy
links.effect: All five LLMs exceeded sixth-grade level; ARI 13.49 to 15.81; OLWF 61.44 to 72.96 versus benchmark 94, so outputs may be challenging for lower health literacy.
links.quote: However, readability levels above recommended benchmarks suggest that current outputs may remain challenging for individuals with lower health literacy.

screen.reason: Evaluates baseline performance, reliability, and readability of multiple commercial LLMs on perinatal depression questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
